items.briefing:
Australia's financial regulator ASIC is warning that scammers are increasingly using AI-generated deepfakes to create convincing fake investment networks targeting Australians. Separately, a China-linked hacker has demonstrated advanced AI capabilities in an attack targeting the Asia-Pacific region, which may include Australian organisations. These developments highlight how AI is actively being weaponised against everyday people and businesses, not just as a future concern.

OpenAI has also rolled out a teen-specific version of ChatGPT in Australia with additional safety features — worth being aware of if you have younger family members using the platform.

**Practical tip:** If you're approached online about an investment opportunity, verify the company independently through ASIC's register at moneysmart.gov.au before engaging.

featured.title: PCI council marks 20 years with AI focus in Kuala Lumpur
featured.summary: Banks and merchants face fresh fraud risks as the council's Kuala Lumpur meeting weighs how AI is changing payment security.
